intended_object: An augmentation map, built only for the proof. It goes from colim F, placed in degree 0, to the degreewise colimit of the stagewise flasque resolutions of the sheaves F(i). It is used to prove that sheaf cohomology commutes with filtered colimits (inferred from the docstring and from how the file uses it).
explanation: This is an auxiliary construction, not a standard object from the literature. It takes the stagewise augmentations `filteredFlasqueResolutionDiagramAugmentation F`, applies the functor `colim` degreewise, and precomposes with the canonical isomorphism from `colim(single₀ ∘ F)` to `single₀(colim F)`. The file then shows that this map is a quasi-isomorphism and that each term of the complex is quasi-flasque. Together these give an acyclic resolution of colim F (lines 517–552), which is used to compute cohomology. So it is a step in the proof that cohomology commutes with filtered colimits. Taking it as the map it is meant to be, the construction is right: it is the colimit of the augmentations, and that is what the docstring says. But it has no counterpart as a standalone mathematical definition. The fixed universe 0 and the setting of `TopCat` are proof-specific choices, not part of the notion.
